subject: HelioBank onboarding — SAML/SCIM staging cutover, IP allowlist & service account ownership
messages:
From: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.com>
To: HelioBank IT Ops <itops@heliobank.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 11 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: HelioBank onboarding — SAML/SCIM staging cutover, IP allowlist & service account ownership

Hi Adam and team,

Thanks again for the sync earlier. Attaching a short preflight matrix and a draft mutual action plan to get us aligned for the staging cutover. Key items we need confirmation on before we schedule the cutover window: 

- IP allowlist ranges we should expect traffic from (for both staging and prod).
- SCIM group mapping for SAML-provisioned users (which AD groups map to Redwood roles).
- Whether HelioBank wants a delegated admin/service account for full tenant operations or a read-only monitoring account.
- Any org policies (e.g., prohibited permission sets) we must bake into the initial provisioning.

Proposed initial staging window: Thu Sep 18, 02:00–05:00 UTC (low-traffic). If that conflicts, tell us preferred windows and we’ll accommodate.

Deliverables from Redwood for the window: canary SAML config, SCIM group mapping run, ephemeral service account for migration testing, and a rollback runbook. Monica will own the runbook; Ben will own the SAML/SCIM changes; Jonas will own service account provisioning. Please confirm the contacts for HelioBank side and the IP ranges below are correct.

Attachments: heliobank_preflight_matrix.xlsx, mutual_action_plan.md

Thanks,

Chloe Martin
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
chloe.martin@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0199

---
Note: For the preflight matrix, we specifically need CIDR blocks for the staging environment and the list of AD group names you expect to provision via SCIM.

From: Adam Shaw <adam.shaw@heliobank.com>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.com>
Cc: HelioBank IT Ops <itops@heliobank.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 11 Sep 2026 12:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: HelioBank onboarding — SAML/SCIM staging cutover, IP allowlist & service account ownership

Chloe —

Appreciate the clear list. Quick answers below: 

- Staging egress (Redwood inbound): 198.51.100.0/24 and 203.0.113.0/28. Prod will be different — we’ll provide that in the prod handoff doc.
- SCIM group mapping: we will map "RB_Engineers" -> Redwood Admin, "RB_Analysts" -> Redwood User, and "RB_SRE" -> Observation (read-only). I’ll attach the AD export in a follow-up if useful.
- Service accounts: we prefer Redwood to create a dedicated service account for provisioning and canary runs with scoped permissions. We will not grant tenant-level delegated admin by default; exceptions require a CISO sign-off.
- Org policies: must disable any account auto-promote rules and enforce MFA for all accounts provisioned by SCIM.

Staging window Sep 18 looks fine; we can also do Sep 19 02:00–04:00 UTC if you prefer earlier UTC finish. 

Adam
Adam Shaw
Director, IT Operations — HelioBank
adam.shaw@heliobank.com

Date: Fri, 11 Sep 2026 16:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: HelioBank onboarding — internal task assignment and rollback plan

Team — looping to confirm internal owners and a short checklist for staging: 

Owners (tentative):
- SAML / Canaries: Ben Carter
- SCIM group mapping + verification tests: Ben Carter
- Service account provisioning (scoped): Jonas Weber
- Runbook + rollback steps + postmortem template: Monica Patel

Checklist for cutover night (staging):
1) Deploy SAML canary to a single tenant namespace, validate IdP metadata exchange, and confirm user login.
2) Run SCIM provisioning for the RB_Engineers test group to staging; verify mapping to Admin role and MFA enforcement.
3) Provision ephemeral service account with limited token lifetime. Verify it cannot escalate to tenant-admin.
4) Execute connectivity test from HelioBank IP ranges; verify allowlist acceptance and token issuance latency.
5) If any validation fails, execute rollback: remove canary config, revoke ephemeral tokens, and open support incident.

I’m drafting staging_runbook_v1.md (attached). Ben/Jonas — please review the specific test cases you’ll run and add any additional log/tracing hooks you want enabled in the console. Jonas: we should pre-create the service account during business hours and validate permissions with a joint test.

-Monica

Monica Patel
Implementation Lead | Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.com

From: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.com>
To: Adam Shaw <adam.shaw@heliobank.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 12 Sep 2026 16:35:00 -0700
Subject: Re: HelioBank onboarding — SAML/SCIM staging cutover, IP allowlist & service account ownership

Adam — thanks for the quick responses. Finalizing the mutual action plan and ownership below: 

Confirmed items:
- Staging allowlist: 198.51.100.0/24, 203.0.113.0/28 (we will only open to these during the window).
- SCIM mapping: RB_Engineers -> Admin, RB_Analysts -> User, RB_SRE -> Observation.
- Service account: Redwood to create ephemeral provisioning account scoped to group-write and user-read only; CISO must approve any elevated scopes.
- Org policies: Redwood will enforce MFA flag for SCIM-provisioned users and not auto-promote via SCIM.

Action items and owners: 
- Ben Carter: SAML canary + SCIM test cases (due 2026-09-16).
- Jonas Weber: create and validate ephemeral service account (due 2026-09-16).
- Monica Patel: finalize runbook and rollback steps, coordinate incident channel (due 2026-09-17).
- HelioBank (Adam): provide final AD export and confirm CISO contact for scope approvals (due 2026-09-15).

Staging window: Sep 18, 02:00–05:00 UTC (confirmed). We’ll do a short preflight call on Sep 17 at 16:00 UTC to walk through the runbook. Meeting invite and the finalized mutual_action_plan.md are attached.

If anything changes on your side, reply to this thread so the runbook owner receives it. Looking forward to a smooth staging cutover.

Best,

Chloe Martin
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
chloe.martin@redwood.com

Attachments: mutual_action_plan.md, staging_runbook_v1.md
